nodes.source_location: Physical M4 webcam checklist and Native Safari checklist

nodes.label: Structural and Semantic Provenance
nodes.rationale: Graph confidence and extraction diagnostics are navigation aids; they do not constitute correctness, performance or coverage evidence.

nodes.label: Calibrated Continuous Boundary Mask
nodes.rationale: Applying the learned gate twice weakened identity; preserve the generated core and soften the established coverage boundary instead.

nodes.label: Fail-closed Release Evidence
nodes.rationale: Unique artifact directories preserve failures, while fingerprints and conservative required gates prevent stale or missing checks being reported as passed.

nodes.label: Native Backend Inference
nodes.rationale: Native MPS/CoreML is retained while browser-only WebGPU generation is deferred until compatibility and matched evaluation exist.

nodes.label: Automatic Tracking Recovery
nodes.rationale: Ordered observations and two-second absence retention replace a permanent ambiguity latch and unnecessary manual reselection.

nodes.label: Server Hardware Acceleration Boundary
nodes.rationale: Hosted inference uses the server; a visiting Mac cannot supply its GPU to the remote backend.

nodes.label: Single-worker Deployment
nodes.rationale: Sessions, jobs and scheduling are process-local; multi-worker deployment requires a shared state design outside the supported demo.

nodes.label: Restrained Camera Interface
nodes.rationale: A dominant preview and collapsed engineering controls simplify editing; canvas frames are not animated and reduced-motion users receive static content.

nodes.label: Correctness then Performance then Quality
nodes.rationale: Reject correctness or tracking failures, require complete live gates, then prefer independently measured fidelity and simpler lower-resource designs.

nodes.label: Worker and HUD Comparison
nodes.rationale: Nine short screens showed no established throughput or jank gain; workers are retained for media isolation and compatibility rather than an invented speedup.

nodes.label: Component-specific Licensing Scope
nodes.rationale: The destination MIT notice does not relicense inherited code, restricted pretrained models, datasets or third-party assets.

nodes.label: Unvalidated Natural Motion Conditions
nodes.rationale: Speech and synthetic composites do not establish broad natural head turns, real crossings, challenging lighting, fairness or foreground-object occlusion.

nodes.label: Temporal Residual Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Reduced residual change can indicate weak or missing editing; interpret it with edit coverage and identity similarity rather than as a perceptual quality score.

nodes.label: Best-effort Ephemeral Session Clearing
nodes.rationale: Clearing references and owned arrays does not guarantee physical memory erasure across Python, Torch, browser and driver allocators.

nodes.label: Product and Verification Fingerprints
nodes.rationale: Bind evidence to the actual runtime/frontend and refuse a mismatched benchmark server; implementation changes invalidate full-product release evidence.

nodes.label: Bounded Binary Streaming
nodes.rationale: One executing frame and one replaceable pending frame bound stale work; revisions prevent old identities appearing after changes.

nodes.label: Research Candidate Release Boundary
nodes.rationale: Historical replay measurements do not certify physical webcam, native Safari, blinded visual review, held-out tracking, or unresolved container security gates.

nodes.label: Legacy desktop application dependencies
nodes.rationale: The file explicitly directs server/container installations to requirements-web.txt instead.

nodes.label: Optional NSFW classifier dependencies
nodes.rationale: Required only when --nsfw-filter is enabled.

nodes.label: Lightweight Live Analysis Models
nodes.rationale: After accelerating generation, repeated SCRFD10GF detection and R50 recognition became the bottleneck; SCRFD500MF and MobileFaceNet reduce that repeated work.

nodes.label: Changed Bottleneck Diagnosis
nodes.rationale: Complete browser profiling showed detector and recognizer costs dominated after generator acceleration, motivating the lightweight live analyser.

hyperedges.label: Separate code model and data rights
